questions.question_text: The value of the definite integral ∫ from 0 to π/2 of (sin³ x) / (sin³ x + cos³ x) dx is equal to: [What is the value of ∫₀^(π/2) (sin³x)/(sin³x + cos³x) dx?]
questions.explanation: Using King's property: I = ∫₀^(π/2) (cos³x)/(cos³x + sin³x) dx. Adding both: 2I = ∫₀^(π/2) 1 dx = π/2 => I = π/4.

questions.explanation: Rapid secretion of LH leading to its maximum level during mid-cycle (LH surge) induces rupture of Graafian follicle and release of ovum.

questions.question_text: मध्य प्रदेश में सांची का महान स्तूप किस जिले में स्थित है और इसका निर्माण किस मौर्य सम्राट ने करवाया था? [In which district of MP is the Great Stupa of Sanchi located and who built it?]
questions.explanation: सांची का स्तूप रायसेन जिले में बेतवा नदी के तट पर स्थित है, जिसका निर्माण सम्राट अशोक ने करवाया था।

questions.question_text: मध्य प्रदेश की सबसे ऊंची चोटी ‘धूपगढ़’ (1350 मीटर) किस पर्वत श्रेणी में स्थित है? [In which mountain range is Dhupgarh, the highest peak of MP, located?]
questions.explanation: धूपगढ़ (1350 मीटर) पचमढ़ी में महादेव पहाड़ियों (सतपुड़ा श्रेणी) में स्थित है।

questions.question_text: In Indian Legal System, the doctrine of 'Basic Structure' of the Constitution was propounded in which landmark judgment? [In which landmark case was the Basic Structure doctrine propounded?]

questions.option_c: Minerva Mills v. Union of India [Minerva Mills v. Union of India]
questions.option_d: Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India [Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India]

Golaknath v. State of Punjab [Golaknath v. State of Punjab]

questions.question_text: In Macroeconomics, the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) deflator is measured as: [How is the GDP Deflator calculated?]
questions.option_a: (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100 [(Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100]
questions.option_b: (Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100 [(Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100]
questions.option_c: Nominal GDP - Real GDP [Nominal GDP - Real GDP]
questions.option_d: GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product [GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product]
options: (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100 [(Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100]
(Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100 [(Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100]
Nominal GDP - Real GDP [Nominal GDP - Real GDP]
GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product [GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product]
questions.explanation: GDP Deflator = (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100, measuring general price inflation across goods produced domestically.

questions.question_text: If a train traveling at 72 km/h crosses a 200 m long platform in 20 seconds, the length of the train is: [Find length of a train crossing a 200m platform in 20s at 72km/h.]
questions.explanation: Speed = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s. Total distance = Speed × Time = 20 × 20 = 400 m. Train length = 400 - 200 = 200 m.

questions.question_text: A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. The frequency of small oscillations about the stable equilibrium position x = 0 is: [A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. What is the frequency of small oscillations?]
questions.explanation: For small oscillations, d²U/dx² at x=0 gives k_eff = 2a. Frequency f = (1/2π) √(k_eff/m) = (1/2π) √(2a/m).

questions.question_text: In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, the stopping potential becomes: [In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, what happens to the stopping potential?]
questions.explanation: Einstein's equation: eV₀ = hν - Φ => eV₀' = 2hν - Φ = 2(eV₀ + Φ) - Φ = 2eV₀ + Φ > 2eV₀.

questions.question_text: Which coordination compound exhibits optical isomerism and forms non-superimposable mirror images? [Which coordination compound shows optical isomerism?]
questions.explanation: Tris(ethylenediamine)cobalt(III) ion [Co(en)₃]³⁺ has D3 point group symmetry without any plane or centre of symmetry.

questions.question_text: The value of the definite integral ∫ from 0 to π/2 of (sin³ x) / (sin³ x + cos³ x) dx is equal to: [What is the value of ∫₀^(π/2) (sin³x)/(sin³x + cos³x) dx?]
questions.explanation: Using King's property: I = ∫₀^(π/2) (cos³x)/(cos³x + sin³x) dx. Adding both: 2I = ∫₀^(π/2) 1 dx = π/2 => I = π/4.

questions.question_text: In human female menstrual cycle, the sudden surge of which pituitary hormone directly triggers ovulation from the Graafian follicle on Day 14? [Which hormone surge directly causes ovulation on Day 14?]
questions.explanation: Rapid secretion of LH leading to its maximum level during mid-cycle (LH surge) induces rupture of Graafian follicle and release of ovum.

questions.question_text: A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. The frequency of small oscillations about the stable equilibrium position x = 0 is: [A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. questions.explanation: For small oscillations, d²U/dx² at x=0 gives k_eff = 2a. Frequency f = (1/2π) √(k_eff/m) = (1/2π) √(2a/m).

questions.question_text: In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, the stopping potential becomes: [In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, what happens to the stopping potential?]

questions.question_text: Which coordination compound exhibits optical isomerism and forms non-superimposable mirror images? [Which coordination compound shows optical isomerism?]

questions.question_text: The value of the definite integral ∫ from 0 to π/2 of (sin³ x) / (sin³ x + cos³ x) dx is equal to: [What is the value of ∫₀^(π/2) (sin³x)/(sin³x + cos³x) dx?]
questions.explanation: Using King's property: I = ∫₀^(π/2) (cos³x)/(cos³x + sin³x) dx. Adding both: 2I = ∫₀^(π/2) 1 dx = π/2 => I = π/4.

questions.question_text: मध्य प्रदेश में सांची का महान स्तूप किस जिले में स्थित है और इसका निर्माण किस मौर्य सम्राट ने करवाया था? [In which district of MP is the Great Stupa of Sanchi located and who built it?]
questions.explanation: सांची का स्तूप रायसेन जिले में बेतवा नदी के तट पर स्थित है, जिसका निर्माण सम्राट अशोक ने करवाया था।

questions.question_text: मध्य प्रदेश की सबसे ऊंची चोटी ‘धूपगढ़’ (1350 मीटर) किस पर्वत श्रेणी में स्थित है? [In which mountain range is Dhupgarh, the highest peak of MP, located?]
questions.explanation: धूपगढ़ (1350 मीटर) पचमढ़ी में महादेव पहाड़ियों (सतपुड़ा श्रेणी) में स्थित है।

questions.question_text: In Indian Legal System, the doctrine of 'Basic Structure' of the Constitution was propounded in which landmark judgment? [In which landmark case was the Basic Structure doctrine propounded?]

questions.option_c: Minerva Mills v. Union of India [Minerva Mills v. Union of India]
questions.option_d: Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India [Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India]

Golaknath v. State of Punjab [Golaknath v. State of Punjab]

questions.question_text: In Macroeconomics, the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) deflator is measured as: [How is the GDP Deflator calculated?]
questions.option_a: (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100 [(Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100]
questions.option_b: (Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100 [(Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100]
questions.option_c: Nominal GDP - Real GDP [Nominal GDP - Real GDP]
questions.option_d: GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product [GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product]
options: (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100 [(Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100]
(Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100 [(Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100]
Nominal GDP - Real GDP [Nominal GDP - Real GDP]
GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product [GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product]
questions.explanation: GDP Deflator = (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100, measuring general price inflation across goods produced domestically.

questions.question_text: If a train traveling at 72 km/h crosses a 200 m long platform in 20 seconds, the length of the train is: [Find length of a train crossing a 200m platform in 20s at 72km/h.]
questions.explanation: Speed = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s. Total distance = Speed × Time = 20 × 20 = 400 m. Train length = 400 - 200 = 200 m.

questions.question_text: A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. The frequency of small oscillations about the stable equilibrium position x = 0 is: [A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. What is the frequency of small oscillations?]
questions.explanation: For small oscillations, d²U/dx² at x=0 gives k_eff = 2a. Frequency f = (1/2π) √(k_eff/m) = (1/2π) √(2a/m).

questions.question_text: In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, the stopping potential becomes: [In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, what happens to the stopping potential?]
questions.explanation: Einstein's equation: eV₀ = hν - Φ => eV₀' = 2hν - Φ = 2(eV₀ + Φ) - Φ = 2eV₀ + Φ > 2eV₀.

questions.question_text: Which coordination compound exhibits optical isomerism and forms non-superimposable mirror images? [Which coordination compound shows optical isomerism?]
questions.explanation: Tris(ethylenediamine)cobalt(III) ion [Co(en)₃]³⁺ has D3 point group symmetry without any plane or centre of symmetry.

questions.question_text: The value of the definite integral ∫ from 0 to π/2 of (sin³ x) / (sin³ x + cos³ x) dx is equal to: [What is the value of ∫₀^(π/2) (sin³x)/(sin³x + cos³x) dx?]
questions.explanation: Using King's property: I = ∫₀^(π/2) (cos³x)/(cos³x + sin³x) dx. Adding both: 2I = ∫₀^(π/2) 1 dx = π/2 => I = π/4.

questions.question_text: In human female menstrual cycle, the sudden surge of which pituitary hormone directly triggers ovulation from the Graafian follicle on Day 14? [Which hormone surge directly causes ovulation on Day 14?]
questions.explanation: Rapid secretion of LH leading to its maximum level during mid-cycle (LH surge) induces rupture of Graafian follicle and release of ovum.

questions.question_text: If a train traveling at 72 km/h crosses a 200 m long platform in 20 seconds, the length of the train is: [Find length of a train crossing a 200m platform in 20s at 72km/h.]
questions.explanation: Speed = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s. Total distance = Speed × Time = 20 × 20 = 400 m. Train length = 400 - 200 = 200 m.

questions.question_text: A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. The frequency of small oscillations about the stable equilibrium position x = 0 is: [A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. What is the frequency of small oscillations?]
questions.explanation: For small oscillations, d²U/dx² at x=0 gives k_eff = 2a. Frequency f = (1/2π) √(k_eff/m) = (1/2π) √(2a/m).

questions.question_text: In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, the stopping potential becomes: [In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, what happens to the stopping potential?]
questions.explanation: Einstein's equation: eV₀ = hν - Φ => eV₀' = 2hν - Φ = 2(eV₀ + Φ) - Φ = 2eV₀ + Φ > 2eV₀.

questions.question_text: Which coordination compound exhibits optical isomerism and forms non-superimposable mirror images? [Which coordination compound shows optical isomerism?]
questions.explanation: Tris(ethylenediamine)cobalt(III) ion [Co(en)₃]³⁺ has D3 point group symmetry without any plane or centre of symmetry.

questions.question_text: The value of the definite integral ∫ from 0 to π/2 of (sin³ x) / (sin³ x + cos³ x) dx is equal to: [What is the value of ∫₀^(π/2) (sin³x)/(sin³x + cos³x) dx?]
questions.explanation: Using King's property: I = ∫₀^(π/2) (cos³x)/(cos³x + sin³x) dx. Adding both: 2I = ∫₀^(π/2) 1 dx = π/2 => I = π/4.

questions.question_text: In human female menstrual cycle, the sudden surge of which pituitary hormone directly triggers ovulation from the Graafian follicle on Day 14? [Which hormone surge directly causes ovulation on Day 14?]
questions.explanation: Rapid secretion of LH leading to its maximum level during mid-cycle (LH surge) induces rupture of Graafian follicle and release of ovum.

questions.question_text: Which cellular organelle is involved in the synthesis of lipids, detoxification of drugs, and steroid hormones in animal cells? [Which organelle synthesizes lipids and detoxifies drugs?]
questions.explanation: Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum is the major site for synthesis of lipid and steroid hormones in animal cells.

questions.question_text: In Macroeconomics, the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) deflator is measured as: [How is the GDP Deflator calculated?]
questions.option_a: (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100 [(Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100]
questions.option_b: (Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100 [(Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100]
questions.option_c: Nominal GDP - Real GDP [Nominal GDP - Real GDP]
questions.option_d: GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product [GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product]
options: (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100 [(Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100]
(Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100 [(Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100]
Nominal GDP - Real GDP [Nominal GDP - Real GDP]
GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product [GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product]
questions.explanation: GDP Deflator = (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100, measuring general price inflation across goods produced domestically.

questions.question_text: If a train traveling at 72 km/h crosses a 200 m long platform in 20 seconds, the length of the train is: [Find length of a train crossing a 200m platform in 20s at 72km/h.]
questions.explanation: Speed = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s. Total distance = Speed × Time = 20 × 20 = 400 m. Train length = 400 - 200 = 200 m.

questions.question_text: A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. The frequency of small oscillations about the stable equilibrium position x = 0 is: [A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. What is the frequency of small oscillations?]
questions.explanation: For small oscillations, d²U/dx² at x=0 gives k_eff = 2a. Frequency f = (1/2π) √(k_eff/m) = (1/2π) √(2a/m).

questions.question_text: In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, the stopping potential becomes: [In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, what happens to the stopping potential?]
questions.explanation: Einstein's equation: eV₀ = hν - Φ => eV₀' = 2hν - Φ = 2(eV₀ + Φ) - Φ = 2eV₀ + Φ > 2eV₀.

questions.question_text: Which coordination compound exhibits optical isomerism and forms non-superimposable mirror images? [Which coordination compound shows optical isomerism?]
questions.explanation: Tris(ethylenediamine)cobalt(III) ion [Co(en)₃]³⁺ has D3 point group symmetry without any plane or centre of symmetry.

questions.question_text: The value of the definite integral ∫ from 0 to π/2 of (sin³ x) / (sin³ x + cos³ x) dx is equal to: [What is the value of ∫₀^(π/2) (sin³x)/(sin³x + cos³x) dx?]
questions.explanation: Using King's property: I = ∫₀^(π/2) (cos³x)/(cos³x + sin³x) dx. Adding both: 2I = ∫₀^(π/2) 1 dx = π/2 => I = π/4.

questions.question_text: In human female menstrual cycle, the sudden surge of which pituitary hormone directly triggers ovulation from the Graafian follicle on Day 14? [Which hormone surge directly causes ovulation on Day 14?]
questions.explanation: Rapid secretion of LH leading to its maximum level during mid-cycle (LH surge) induces rupture of Graafian follicle and release of ovum.

questions.question_text: मध्य प्रदेश की सबसे ऊंची चोटी ‘धूपगढ़’ (1350 मीटर) किस पर्वत श्रेणी में स्थित है? [In which mountain range is Dhupgarh, the highest peak of MP, located?]
questions.explanation: धूपगढ़ (1350 मीटर) पचमढ़ी में महादेव पहाड़ियों (सतपुड़ा श्रेणी) में स्थित है।

questions.question_text: In Indian Legal System, the doctrine of 'Basic Structure' of the Constitution was propounded in which landmark judgment? [In which landmark case was the Basic Structure doctrine propounded?]
questions.option_a: Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (1973) [Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (1973)]
questions.option_b: Golaknath v. State of Punjab [Golaknath v. State of Punjab]
questions.option_c: Minerva Mills v. Union of India [Minerva Mills v. Union of India]
questions.option_d: Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India [Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India]
options: Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (1973) [Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (1973)]
Golaknath v. State of Punjab [Golaknath v. State of Punjab]
Minerva Mills v. Union of India [Minerva Mills v. Union of India]
Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India [Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India]
questions.explanation: A 13-judge bench in Kesavananda Bharati (1973) held that Parliament cannot alter the basic structure of the Constitution.

questions.question_text: Choose the word which is closest in meaning (Synonym) to 'EPHEMERAL': [What is the synonym of 'Ephemeral'?]
questions.explanation: Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time; transitory, fleeting.

questions.question_text: In Macroeconomics, the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) deflator is measured as: [How is the GDP Deflator calculated?]
questions.option_a: (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100 [(Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100]
questions.option_b: (Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100 [(Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100]
questions.option_c: Nominal GDP - Real GDP [Nominal GDP - Real GDP]
questions.option_d: GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product [GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product]
options: (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100 [(Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100]
(Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100 [(Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100]
Nominal GDP - Real GDP [Nominal GDP - Real GDP]
GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product [GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product]
questions.explanation: GDP Deflator = (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100, measuring general price inflation across goods produced domestically.

questions.question_text: If a train traveling at 72 km/h crosses a 200 m long platform in 20 seconds, the length of the train is: [Find length of a train crossing a 200m platform in 20s at 72km/h.]
questions.explanation: Speed = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s. Total distance = Speed × Time = 20 × 20 = 400 m. Train length = 400 - 200 = 200 m.

questions.question_text: A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. The frequency of small oscillations about the stable equilibrium position x = 0 is: [A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. What is the frequency of small oscillations?]
questions.explanation: For small oscillations, d²U/dx² at x=0 gives k_eff = 2a. Frequency f = (1/2π) √(k_eff/m) = (1/2π) √(2a/m).

questions.question_text: In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, the stopping potential becomes: [In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, what happens to the stopping potential?]
questions.explanation: Einstein's equation: eV₀ = hν - Φ => eV₀' = 2hν - Φ = 2(eV₀ + Φ) - Φ = 2eV₀ + Φ > 2eV₀.

questions.question_text: Which coordination compound exhibits optical isomerism and forms non-superimposable mirror images? [Which coordination compound shows optical isomerism?]
questions.explanation: Tris(ethylenediamine)cobalt(III) ion [Co(en)₃]³⁺ has D3 point group symmetry without any plane or centre of symmetry.

questions.question_text: The value of the definite integral ∫ from 0 to π/2 of (sin³ x) / (sin³ x + cos³ x) dx is equal to: [What is the value of ∫₀^(π/2) (sin³x)/(sin³x + cos³x) dx?]
questions.explanation: Using King's property: I = ∫₀^(π/2) (cos³x)/(cos³x + sin³x) dx. Adding both: 2I = ∫₀^(π/2) 1 dx = π/2 => I = π/4.

questions.question_text: In human female menstrual cycle, the sudden surge of which pituitary hormone directly triggers ovulation from the Graafian follicle on Day 14? [Which hormone surge directly causes ovulation on Day 14?]
questions.explanation: Rapid secretion of LH leading to its maximum level during mid-cycle (LH surge) induces rupture of Graafian follicle and release of ovum.

questions.question_text: Which cellular organelle is involved in the synthesis of lipids, detoxification of drugs, and steroid hormones in animal cells? [Which organelle synthesizes lipids and detoxifies drugs?]
questions.explanation: Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum is the major site for synthesis of lipid and steroid hormones in animal cells.

questions.question_text: If a train traveling at 72 km/h crosses a 200 m long platform in 20 seconds, the length of the train is: [Find length of a train crossing a 200m platform in 20s at 72km/h.]

questions.question_text: A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. The frequency of small oscillations about the stable equilibrium position x = 0 is: [A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. What is the frequency of small oscillations?]
questions.explanation: For small oscillations, d²U/dx² at x=0 gives k_eff = 2a. Frequency f = (1/2π) √(k_eff/m) = (1/2π) √(2a/m).

questions.question_text: In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, the stopping potential becomes: [In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, what happens to the stopping potential?]
questions.explanation: Einstein's equation: eV₀ = hν - Φ => eV₀' = 2hν - Φ = 2(eV₀ + Φ) - Φ = 2eV₀ + Φ > 2eV₀.

questions.question_text: Which coordination compound exhibits optical isomerism and forms non-superimposable mirror images? [Which coordination compound shows optical isomerism?]

questions.question_text: The value of the definite integral ∫ from 0 to π/2 of (sin³ x) / (sin³ x + cos³ x) dx is equal to: [What is the value of ∫₀^(π/2) (sin³x)/(sin³x + cos³x) dx?]
questions.explanation: Using King's property: I = ∫₀^(π/2) (cos³x)/(cos³x + sin³x) dx. Adding both: 2I = ∫₀^(π/2) 1 dx = π/2 => I = π/4.

questions.question_text: In human female menstrual cycle, the sudden surge of which pituitary hormone directly triggers ovulation from the Graafian follicle on Day 14? [Which hormone surge directly causes ovulation on Day 14?]
questions.explanation: Rapid secretion of LH leading to its maximum level during mid-cycle (LH surge) induces rupture of Graafian follicle and release of ovum.

questions.question_text: Which coordination compound exhibits optical isomerism and forms non-superimposable mirror images? [Which coordination compound shows optical isomerism?]

questions.question_text: The value of the definite integral ∫ from 0 to π/2 of (sin³ x) / (sin³ x + cos³ x) dx is equal to: [What is the value of ∫₀^(π/2) (sin³x)/(sin³x + cos³x) dx?]

questions.question_text: In Macroeconomics, the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) deflator is measured as: [How is the GDP Deflator calculated?]
questions.option_a: (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100 [(Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100]
questions.option_b: (Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100 [(Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100]
questions.option_c: Nominal GDP - Real GDP [Nominal GDP - Real GDP]
questions.option_d: GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product [GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product]
options: (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100 [(Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100]
(Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100 [(Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100]
Nominal GDP - Real GDP [Nominal GDP - Real GDP]
GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product [GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product]
questions.explanation: GDP Deflator = (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100, measuring general price inflation across goods produced domestically.

questions.question_text: If a train traveling at 72 km/h crosses a 200 m long platform in 20 seconds, the length of the train is: [Find length of a train crossing a 200m platform in 20s at 72km/h.]
questions.explanation: Speed = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s. Total distance = Speed × Time = 20 × 20 = 400 m. Train length = 400 - 200 = 200 m.

questions.question_text: A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. The frequency of small oscillations about the stable equilibrium position x = 0 is: [A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. What is the frequency of small oscillations?]
questions.explanation: For small oscillations, d²U/dx² at x=0 gives k_eff = 2a. Frequency f = (1/2π) √(k_eff/m) = (1/2π) √(2a/m).

questions.question_text: In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, the stopping potential becomes: [In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, what happens to the stopping potential?]
questions.explanation: Einstein's equation: eV₀ = hν - Φ => eV₀' = 2hν - Φ = 2(eV₀ + Φ) - Φ = 2eV₀ + Φ > 2eV₀.

questions.question_text: Which coordination compound exhibits optical isomerism and forms non-superimposable mirror images? [Which coordination compound shows optical isomerism?]
questions.explanation: Tris(ethylenediamine)cobalt(III) ion [Co(en)₃]³⁺ has D3 point group symmetry without any plane or centre of symmetry.

questions.question_text: The value of the definite integral ∫ from 0 to π/2 of (sin³ x) / (sin³ x + cos³ x) dx is equal to: [What is the value of ∫₀^(π/2) (sin³x)/(sin³x + cos³x) dx?]
questions.explanation: Using King's property: I = ∫₀^(π/2) (cos³x)/(cos³x + sin³x) dx. Adding both: 2I = ∫₀^(π/2) 1 dx = π/2 => I = π/4.

questions.question_text: In human female menstrual cycle, the sudden surge of which pituitary hormone directly triggers ovulation from the Graafian follicle on Day 14? [Which hormone surge directly causes ovulation on Day 14?]
questions.explanation: Rapid secretion of LH leading to its maximum level during mid-cycle (LH surge) induces rupture of Graafian follicle and release of ovum.

questions.question_text: Which cellular organelle is involved in the synthesis of lipids, detoxification of drugs, and steroid hormones in animal cells? [Which organelle synthesizes lipids and detoxifies drugs?]
questions.explanation: Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum is the major site for synthesis of lipid and steroid hormones in animal cells.

questions.question_text: मध्य प्रदेश में सांची का महान स्तूप किस जिले में स्थित है और इसका निर्माण किस मौर्य सम्राट ने करवाया था? [In which district of MP is the Great Stupa of Sanchi located and who built it?]
questions.explanation: सांची का स्तूप रायसेन जिले में बेतवा नदी के तट पर स्थित है, जिसका निर्माण सम्राट अशोक ने करवाया था।

questions.question_text: मध्य प्रदेश की सबसे ऊंची चोटी ‘धूपगढ़’ (1350 मीटर) किस पर्वत श्रेणी में स्थित है? [In which mountain range is Dhupgarh, the highest peak of MP, located?]
questions.explanation: धूपगढ़ (1350 मीटर) पचमढ़ी में महादेव पहाड़ियों (सतपुड़ा श्रेणी) में स्थित है।

questions.question_text: In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, the stopping potential becomes: [In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, what happens to the stopping potential?]

questions.question_text: The value of the definite integral ∫ from 0 to π/2 of (sin³ x) / (sin³ x + cos³ x) dx is equal to: [What is the value of ∫₀^(π/2) (sin³x)/(sin³x + cos³x) dx?]
questions.explanation: Using King's property: I = ∫₀^(π/2) (cos³x)/(cos³x + sin³x) dx. Adding both: 2I = ∫₀^(π/2) 1 dx = π/2 => I = π/4.

questions.question_text: In human female menstrual cycle, the sudden surge of which pituitary hormone directly triggers ovulation from the Graafian follicle on Day 14? [Which hormone surge directly causes ovulation on Day 14?]
questions.explanation: Rapid secretion of LH leading to its maximum level during mid-cycle (LH surge) induces rupture of Graafian follicle and release of ovum.

questions.question_text: If a train traveling at 72 km/h crosses a 200 m long platform in 20 seconds, the length of the train is: [Find length of a train crossing a 200m platform in 20s at 72km/h.]
questions.explanation: Speed = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s. Total distance = Speed × Time = 20 × 20 = 400 m. Train length = 400 - 200 = 200 m.

questions.question_text: A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. The frequency of small oscillations about the stable equilibrium position x = 0 is: [A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. What is the frequency of small oscillations?]
questions.explanation: For small oscillations, d²U/dx² at x=0 gives k_eff = 2a. Frequency f = (1/2π) √(k_eff/m) = (1/2π) √(2a/m).

questions.question_text: In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, the stopping potential becomes: [In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, what happens to the stopping potential?]
questions.explanation: Einstein's equation: eV₀ = hν - Φ => eV₀' = 2hν - Φ = 2(eV₀ + Φ) - Φ = 2eV₀ + Φ > 2eV₀.

questions.question_text: Which coordination compound exhibits optical isomerism and forms non-superimposable mirror images? [Which coordination compound shows optical isomerism?]
questions.explanation: Tris(ethylenediamine)cobalt(III) ion [Co(en)₃]³⁺ has D3 point group symmetry without any plane or centre of symmetry.

questions.question_text: The value of the definite integral ∫ from 0 to π/2 of (sin³ x) / (sin³ x + cos³ x) dx is equal to: [What is the value of ∫₀^(π/2) (sin³x)/(sin³x + cos³x) dx?]
questions.explanation: Using King's property: I = ∫₀^(π/2) (cos³x)/(cos³x + sin³x) dx. Adding both: 2I = ∫₀^(π/2) 1 dx = π/2 => I = π/4.

questions.question_text: In human female menstrual cycle, the sudden surge of which pituitary hormone directly triggers ovulation from the Graafian follicle on Day 14? [Which hormone surge directly causes ovulation on Day 14?]
questions.explanation: Rapid secretion of LH leading to its maximum level during mid-cycle (LH surge) induces rupture of Graafian follicle and release of ovum.

questions.question_text: Which cellular organelle is involved in the synthesis of lipids, detoxification of drugs, and steroid hormones in animal cells? [Which organelle synthesizes lipids and detoxifies drugs?]
questions.explanation: Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum is the major site for synthesis of lipid and steroid hormones in animal cells.

questions.question_text: If a train traveling at 72 km/h crosses a 200 m long platform in 20 seconds, the length of the train is: [Find length of a train crossing a 200m platform in 20s at 72km/h.]

questions.question_text: A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. The frequency of small oscillations about the stable equilibrium position x = 0 is: [A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. What is the frequency of small oscillations?]
questions.explanation: For small oscillations, d²U/dx² at x=0 gives k_eff = 2a. Frequency f = (1/2π) √(k_eff/m) = (1/2π) √(2a/m).

questions.question_text: In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, the stopping potential becomes: [In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, what happens to the stopping potential?]
questions.explanation: Einstein's equation: eV₀ = hν - Φ => eV₀' = 2hν - Φ = 2(eV₀ + Φ) - Φ = 2eV₀ + Φ > 2eV₀.

questions.question_text: Which coordination compound exhibits optical isomerism and forms non-superimposable mirror images? [Which coordination compound shows optical isomerism?]
questions.explanation: Tris(ethylenediamine)cobalt(III) ion [Co(en)₃]³⁺ has D3 point group symmetry without any plane or centre of symmetry.

questions.question_text: The value of the definite integral ∫ from 0 to π/2 of (sin³ x) / (sin³ x + cos³ x) dx is equal to: [What is the value of ∫₀^(π/2) (sin³x)/(sin³x + cos³x) dx?]
questions.explanation: Using King's property: I = ∫₀^(π/2) (cos³x)/(cos³x + sin³x) dx. Adding both: 2I = ∫₀^(π/2) 1 dx = π/2 => I = π/4.

questions.question_text: In human female menstrual cycle, the sudden surge of which pituitary hormone directly triggers ovulation from the Graafian follicle on Day 14? [Which hormone surge directly causes ovulation on Day 14?]
questions.explanation: Rapid secretion of LH leading to its maximum level during mid-cycle (LH surge) induces rupture of Graafian follicle and release of ovum.

questions.question_text: Which cellular organelle is involved in the synthesis of lipids, detoxification of drugs, and steroid hormones in animal cells? [Which organelle synthesizes lipids and detoxifies drugs?]

questions.question_text: If a train traveling at 72 km/h crosses a 200 m long platform in 20 seconds, the length of the train is: [Find length of a train crossing a 200m platform in 20s at 72km/h.]
questions.explanation: Speed = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s. Total distance = Speed × Time = 20 × 20 = 400 m. Train length = 400 - 200 = 200 m.

questions.question_text: A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. The frequency of small oscillations about the stable equilibrium position x = 0 is: [A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. What is the frequency of small oscillations?]
questions.explanation: For small oscillations, d²U/dx² at x=0 gives k_eff = 2a. Frequency f = (1/2π) √(k_eff/m) = (1/2π) √(2a/m).

questions.question_text: In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, the stopping potential becomes: [In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, what happens to the stopping potential?]
questions.explanation: Einstein's equation: eV₀ = hν - Φ => eV₀' = 2hν - Φ = 2(eV₀ + Φ) - Φ = 2eV₀ + Φ > 2eV₀.

questions.question_text: Which coordination compound exhibits optical isomerism and forms non-superimposable mirror images? [Which coordination compound shows optical isomerism?]
questions.explanation: Tris(ethylenediamine)cobalt(III) ion [Co(en)₃]³⁺ has D3 point group symmetry without any plane or centre of symmetry.

questions.question_text: The value of the definite integral ∫ from 0 to π/2 of (sin³ x) / (sin³ x + cos³ x) dx is equal to: [What is the value of ∫₀^(π/2) (sin³x)/(sin³x + cos³x) dx?]
questions.explanation: Using King's property: I = ∫₀^(π/2) (cos³x)/(cos³x + sin³x) dx. Adding both: 2I = ∫₀^(π/2) 1 dx = π/2 => I = π/4.

questions.question_text: In human female menstrual cycle, the sudden surge of which pituitary hormone directly triggers ovulation from the Graafian follicle on Day 14? [Which hormone surge directly causes ovulation on Day 14?]
questions.explanation: Rapid secretion of LH leading to its maximum level during mid-cycle (LH surge) induces rupture of Graafian follicle and release of ovum.

questions.question_text: Which cellular organelle is involved in the synthesis of lipids, detoxification of drugs, and steroid hormones in animal cells? [Which organelle synthesizes lipids and detoxifies drugs?]
questions.explanation: Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum is the major site for synthesis of lipid and steroid hormones in animal cells.

questions.question_text: If a train traveling at 72 km/h crosses a 200 m long platform in 20 seconds, the length of the train is: [Find length of a train crossing a 200m platform in 20s at 72km/h.]
questions.explanation: Speed = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s. Total distance = Speed × Time = 20 × 20 = 400 m. Train length = 400 - 200 = 200 m.

questions.question_text: A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. The frequency of small oscillations about the stable equilibrium position x = 0 is: [A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. What is the frequency of small oscillations?]
questions.explanation: For small oscillations, d²U/dx² at x=0 gives k_eff = 2a. Frequency f = (1/2π) √(k_eff/m) = (1/2π) √(2a/m).

questions.question_text: In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, the stopping potential becomes: [In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, what happens to the stopping potential?]
questions.explanation: Einstein's equation: eV₀ = hν - Φ => eV₀' = 2hν - Φ = 2(eV₀ + Φ) - Φ = 2eV₀ + Φ > 2eV₀.

questions.question_text: Which coordination compound exhibits optical isomerism and forms non-superimposable mirror images? [Which coordination compound shows optical isomerism?]
questions.explanation: Tris(ethylenediamine)cobalt(III) ion [Co(en)₃]³⁺ has D3 point group symmetry without any plane or centre of symmetry.

questions.question_text: If a train traveling at 72 km/h crosses a 200 m long platform in 20 seconds, the length of the train is: [Find length of a train crossing a 200m platform in 20s at 72km/h.]
questions.explanation: Speed = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s. Total distance = Speed × Time = 20 × 20 = 400 m. Train length = 400 - 200 = 200 m.

questions.question_text: A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. The frequency of small oscillations about the stable equilibrium position x = 0 is: [A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. What is the frequency of small oscillations?]
questions.explanation: For small oscillations, d²U/dx² at x=0 gives k_eff = 2a. Frequency f = (1/2π) √(k_eff/m) = (1/2π) √(2a/m).

questions.question_text: In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, the stopping potential becomes: [In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, what happens to the stopping potential?]
questions.explanation: Einstein's equation: eV₀ = hν - Φ => eV₀' = 2hν - Φ = 2(eV₀ + Φ) - Φ = 2eV₀ + Φ > 2eV₀.

questions.question_text: Which coordination compound exhibits optical isomerism and forms non-superimposable mirror images? [Which coordination compound shows optical isomerism?]
questions.explanation: Tris(ethylenediamine)cobalt(III) ion [Co(en)₃]³⁺ has D3 point group symmetry without any plane or centre of symmetry.

questions.question_text: The value of the definite integral ∫ from 0 to π/2 of (sin³ x) / (sin³ x + cos³ x) dx is equal to: [What is the value of ∫₀^(π/2) (sin³x)/(sin³x + cos³x) dx?]
questions.explanation: Using King's property: I = ∫₀^(π/2) (cos³x)/(cos³x + sin³x) dx. Adding both: 2I = ∫₀^(π/2) 1 dx = π/2 => I = π/4.

questions.question_text: In human female menstrual cycle, the sudden surge of which pituitary hormone directly triggers ovulation from the Graafian follicle on Day 14? [Which hormone surge directly causes ovulation on Day 14?]
questions.explanation: Rapid secretion of LH leading to its maximum level during mid-cycle (LH surge) induces rupture of Graafian follicle and release of ovum.

questions.question_text: Which cellular organelle is involved in the synthesis of lipids, detoxification of drugs, and steroid hormones in animal cells? [Which organelle synthesizes lipids and detoxifies drugs?]
questions.explanation: Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum is the major site for synthesis of lipid and steroid hormones in animal cells.

questions.question_text: If a train traveling at 72 km/h crosses a 200 m long platform in 20 seconds, the length of the train is: [Find length of a train crossing a 200m platform in 20s at 72km/h.]

questions.question_text: A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. The frequency of small oscillations about the stable equilibrium position x = 0 is: [A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. What is the frequency of small oscillations?]
questions.explanation: For small oscillations, d²U/dx² at x=0 gives k_eff = 2a. Frequency f = (1/2π) √(k_eff/m) = (1/2π) √(2a/m).

questions.question_text: In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, the stopping potential becomes: [In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, what happens to the stopping potential?]
questions.explanation: Einstein's equation: eV₀ = hν - Φ => eV₀' = 2hν - Φ = 2(eV₀ + Φ) - Φ = 2eV₀ + Φ > 2eV₀.

questions.question_text: Which coordination compound exhibits optical isomerism and forms non-superimposable mirror images? [Which coordination compound shows optical isomerism?]
questions.explanation: Tris(ethylenediamine)cobalt(III) ion [Co(en)₃]³⁺ has D3 point group symmetry without any plane or centre of symmetry.

questions.question_text: The value of the definite integral ∫ from 0 to π/2 of (sin³ x) / (sin³ x + cos³ x) dx is equal to: [What is the value of ∫₀^(π/2) (sin³x)/(sin³x + cos³x) dx?]
questions.explanation: Using King's property: I = ∫₀^(π/2) (cos³x)/(cos³x + sin³x) dx. Adding both: 2I = ∫₀^(π/2) 1 dx = π/2 => I = π/4.

questions.question_text: In human female menstrual cycle, the sudden surge of which pituitary hormone directly triggers ovulation from the Graafian follicle on Day 14? [Which hormone surge directly causes ovulation on Day 14?]
questions.explanation: Rapid secretion of LH leading to its maximum level during mid-cycle (LH surge) induces rupture of Graafian follicle and release of ovum.

questions.question_text: Which cellular organelle is involved in the synthesis of lipids, detoxification of drugs, and steroid hormones in animal cells? [Which organelle synthesizes lipids and detoxifies drugs?]
questions.explanation: Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum is the major site for synthesis of lipid and steroid hormones in animal cells.

questions.question_text: मध्य प्रदेश में सांची का महान स्तूप किस जिले में स्थित है और इसका निर्माण किस मौर्य सम्राट ने करवाया था? [In which district of MP is the Great Stupa of Sanchi located and who built it?]

questions.question_text: In Macroeconomics, the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) deflator is measured as: [How is the GDP Deflator calculated?]
questions.option_a: (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100 [(Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100]
questions.option_b: (Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100 [(Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100]
questions.option_c: Nominal GDP - Real GDP [Nominal GDP - Real GDP]
questions.option_d: GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product [GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product]
options: (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100 [(Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100]
(Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100 [(Real GDP / Nominal GDP) × 100]
Nominal GDP - Real GDP [Nominal GDP - Real GDP]
GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product [GDP at Factor Cost / Net Domestic Product]
questions.explanation: GDP Deflator = (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100, measuring general price inflation across goods produced domestically.

questions.question_text: If a train traveling at 72 km/h crosses a 200 m long platform in 20 seconds, the length of the train is: [Find length of a train crossing a 200m platform in 20s at 72km/h.]
questions.explanation: Speed = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s. Total distance = Speed × Time = 20 × 20 = 400 m. Train length = 400 - 200 = 200 m.

questions.question_text: A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. The frequency of small oscillations about the stable equilibrium position x = 0 is: [A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. What is the frequency of small oscillations?]
questions.explanation: For small oscillations, d²U/dx² at x=0 gives k_eff = 2a. Frequency f = (1/2π) √(k_eff/m) = (1/2π) √(2a/m).

questions.question_text: In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, the stopping potential becomes: [In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, what happens to the stopping potential?]
questions.explanation: Einstein's equation: eV₀ = hν - Φ => eV₀' = 2hν - Φ = 2(eV₀ + Φ) - Φ = 2eV₀ + Φ > 2eV₀.

questions.question_text: Which cellular organelle is involved in the synthesis of lipids, detoxification of drugs, and steroid hormones in animal cells? [Which organelle synthesizes lipids and detoxifies drugs?]

questions.question_text: In human female menstrual cycle, the sudden surge of which pituitary hormone directly triggers ovulation from the Graafian follicle on Day 14? [Which hormone surge directly causes ovulation on Day 14?]
questions.explanation: Rapid secretion of LH leading to its maximum level during mid-cycle (LH surge) induces rupture of Graafian follicle and release of ovum.

questions.question_text: Which cellular organelle is involved in the synthesis of lipids, detoxification of drugs, and steroid hormones in animal cells? [Which organelle synthesizes lipids and detoxifies drugs?]
questions.explanation: Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum is the major site for synthesis of lipid and steroid hormones in animal cells.

questions.question_text: If a train traveling at 72 km/h crosses a 200 m long platform in 20 seconds, the length of the train is: [Find length of a train crossing a 200m platform in 20s at 72km/h.]
questions.explanation: Speed = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s. Total distance = Speed × Time = 20 × 20 = 400 m. Train length = 400 - 200 = 200 m.

questions.question_text: A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. The frequency of small oscillations about the stable equilibrium position x = 0 is: [A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. What is the frequency of small oscillations?]
questions.explanation: For small oscillations, d²U/dx² at x=0 gives k_eff = 2a. Frequency f = (1/2π) √(k_eff/m) = (1/2π) √(2a/m).

questions.question_text: In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, the stopping potential becomes: [In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, what happens to the stopping potential?]
questions.explanation: Einstein's equation: eV₀ = hν - Φ => eV₀' = 2hν - Φ = 2(eV₀ + Φ) - Φ = 2eV₀ + Φ > 2eV₀.

questions.question_text: Which coordination compound exhibits optical isomerism and forms non-superimposable mirror images? [Which coordination compound shows optical isomerism?]

questions.question_text: If a train traveling at 72 km/h crosses a 200 m long platform in 20 seconds, the length of the train is: [Find length of a train crossing a 200m platform in 20s at 72km/h.]

questions.question_text: A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. The frequency of small oscillations about the stable equilibrium position x = 0 is: [A particle of mass m moves along the x-axis with potential energy U(x) = ax² - bx⁴. What is the frequency of small oscillations?]
questions.explanation: For small oscillations, d²U/dx² at x=0 gives k_eff = 2a. Frequency f = (1/2π) √(k_eff/m) = (1/2π) √(2a/m).

questions.question_text: In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, the stopping potential becomes: [In a photo-electric experiment, if the frequency of incident radiation is doubled, what happens to the stopping potential?]
questions.explanation: Einstein's equation: eV₀ = hν - Φ => eV₀' = 2hν - Φ = 2(eV₀ + Φ) - Φ = 2eV₀ + Φ > 2eV₀.

questions.question_text: Which coordination compound exhibits optical isomerism and forms non-superimposable mirror images? [Which coordination compound shows optical isomerism?]

questions.question_text: The value of the definite integral ∫ from 0 to π/2 of (sin³ x) / (sin³ x + cos³ x) dx is equal to: [What is the value of ∫₀^(π/2) (sin³x)/(sin³x + cos³x) dx?]
questions.explanation: Using King's property: I = ∫₀^(π/2) (cos³x)/(cos³x + sin³x) dx. Adding both: 2I = ∫₀^(π/2) 1 dx = π/2 => I = π/4.

questions.question_text: In human female menstrual cycle, the sudden surge of which pituitary hormone directly triggers ovulation from the Graafian follicle on Day 14? [Which hormone surge directly causes ovulation on Day 14?]
questions.explanation: Rapid secretion of LH leading to its maximum level during mid-cycle (LH surge) induces rupture of Graafian follicle and release of ovum.

questions.question_text: Which cellular organelle is involved in the synthesis of lipids, detoxification of drugs, and steroid hormones in animal cells? [Which organelle synthesizes lipids and detoxifies drugs?]
questions.explanation: Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum is the major site for synthesis of lipid and steroid hormones in animal cells.
